# Batch

Stock `mes.batch.*` (plus `mes.production.mesEquipmentManager`/`mesEnumManager`/`mesSignatureTemplateManager`/`mesAuthChallengeList` and `mes.production.batchSelector`) screens for ISA-88 batch procedures. The menu order is the build order - work top to bottom the first time through.

## Configuration

1. **Equipment Manager** (Production module) - build the equipment model (Enterprise/Site/Area/Process Cell/Unit) a batch runs against.
2. **Enum Manager** - register the option list for any Enum-typed parameter (e.g. a unit-of-measure or status parameter) before a phase/recipe references it - writing a value that isn't a registered member fails at runtime.
3. **Unit Class Manager** - define unit classes: what a physical unit is capable of running.
4. **Unit Manager** - assign a unit class to the units under a selected Process Cell.
5. **Phase Manager** - build phase classes and phases (the most granular unit of recipe logic) and attach them to a unit class so they show up in the Recipe Editor palette.
6. **Recipe Editor** - author master recipes (Procedure > Unit Procedure > optional Operation > Phase, wired up with transitions) and validate them - an invalid recipe can't be queued.
7. **Formula Manager** (optional) - save a named, pre-scaled set of parameter values for a recipe, for repeat batches that don't need every value re-entered by hand.
8. **Signature Templates** - define who (user/role expression) must sign off on a batch command, for any command that should require e-signature authorization.

## Execution & reporting

9. **Batch List** - browse the batch queue: queued, running, and completed batches.
10. **Batch Controller** - select a batch and command it (start/hold/pause/resume/abort) or step it manually.
11. **Recipe Monitor** - watch a running batch's procedure chart advance live.
12. **Message List** - answer operator prompts (Value Prompt / User Message phases) raised by a running batch.
13. **Auth Challenges** - complete pending e-signature authorization challenges triggered by a batch command.
14. **EBR Viewer** - view a batch's Electronic Batch Record - what actually happened - once it's running or complete.
